theme_preference: Light mode by default (optimizes visibility for fast cashier tasks), with optional dark mode toggle.

typography.notes: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings. Use Clash Display for structural headings and Manrope for data-heavy tables and general text.

colors.rules: Avoid default SaaS blue. Never use pure black (#000000). Ensure APCA contrast ratio compliance. Use primary color exclusively for primary actions (Checkout, Add, Save). Do not use teal green/blue (#1B93A4).

layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-4 to p-8 for containers. Use tailwind scale.

pos_cashier_screen.structure: Split screen layout: 65% left (Product Grid), 35% right (Cart Panel).
pos_cashier_screen.product_grid: Grid layout: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Minimalist product cards without drop shadows. Focus on the image and price.
pos_cashier_screen.cart_panel: Sticky to the right side, height full screen (h-screen). Flex column layout. Items list takes flex-1 (scrollable). Checkout total and button fixed at bottom.

dashboard_screen.structure: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
dashboard_screen.widgets: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow. Use recharts for data visualization.

components.general: Do not use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use shadcn dropdown, dialog, table, tabs.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with distinct interaction animations (hover:bg-primary/90).
components.inputs: Solid borders, light background. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary.
components.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular edges with max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). Avoid heavy box-shadows. Use 1px borders (border-border).
components.toast: Use sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Produk ditambahkan', 'Pembayaran berhasil').
components.tables: Use shadcn table. Left align text, right align numerical values (Currency).
components.data_visualization: Use recharts for sales trends and category breakdown.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have hover states (e.g., button hover color, card -translate-y-1).
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out). Do not use transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for product grid items.

accessibility.contrast: Text over images must use gradient overlays or text-shadow for readability.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings on interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="checkout-button"`).

specific_requirements.localization: Language: Bahasa Indonesia. Currency: Rupiah (Rp). Format currency as Rp X.XXX.XXX.
features: POS Cashier screen: product grid, category filter, shopping cart, checkout (cash/card/QRIS), receipt printing simulation
Complete Reports dashboard (sales over time, top products, profit, sales by category, payment method breakdown, date range filters)

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Do not apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) or Lucide-react for iconography. No generic SVGs without a unified style.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup routing and pages for Login, POS Cashier, Dashboard (Reports), Product Management, Category Management, User Management, and History.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Implement the POS Cashier screen focusing on speed and layout (split grid/cart). Populate with mock data and the provided product images.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Implement the Reports Dashboard utilizing Recharts for data visualization (Sales over time, top products pie chart).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement CRUD views for Products and Categories. Make use of shadcn dialogs and forms.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all text uses Bahasa Indonesia and currency is properly formatted as Rupiah.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Integrate 'sonner' for toast notifications on actions like Add to Cart, Checkout, and Save.
